title: Evaluation of an operand
statement: Given an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs and a list of previously computed Boolean values, an input operand evaluates to its assigned value, a negated input operand to its complement, and a line operand to the list entry at its index, or to false if that index is out of range.
